messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Container restart surge on cluster shard-14. 75% of runtime pods hitting CrashLoopBackOff with SIGSEGV (signal 11). Errors started ~5m ago. Affected service: inference-runtime (v2.3.1+, TRT-optimized). Alert groups: infra, eng-runtime, oncall. Logs attached in thread.
sylvia (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Can someone grab recent pod logs + dmesg/core dump? I'll start initial triage. @kevin @emma
emma (sre): On it. Running `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-runtime -o wide` now. Seeing many pods RestartCount > 10. Node mapping: most on node-gpu-14 and node-gpu-15.
kevin (eng-runtime): I pulled a crash log from one pod:```
#0 0x7f9a8b4c in custom_kernel::invoke(...) at fused_kernels.cu:814
#1 0x7f9a8f3a in run_inference at runtime.cc:412
#2 0x7f9a9123 in handle_request at server.cc:229
#3 0x55555b0 in main
```Stack trace shows segfault inside our fused CUDA kernel. Possible bad kernel path in latest TRT wrapper.```
raj (eng-ml): We rolled v2.3.1 yesterday with new fused attention/kv cache changes. Could be a particular sequence length + quantization combo hitting a codepath.
sylvia (oncall): Good catch. Emma, can you collect `dmesg | tail -n 100` from node-gpu-14? Also `kubectl describe pod` for one restart.
emma (sre): dmesg snippet: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:07:00): 31, Ch 00000041, intr 10000268`. Also kernel shows segfault at address in device memory. Full `kubectl describe` attached in paste link: https://paste.redwood/abc123
kevin (eng-runtime): That Xid 31 usually points to illegal memory access in CUDA kernel. Quick mitigation: revert to non-fused kernel variant or set env to disable TRT fusion. We have runtime env `TRT_FUSE=1` default. Set `TRT_FUSE=0` and restart pods, will that be feasible at scale? It avoids the fast path but should be safer.
raj (eng-ml): Confirmed. The quant profile for int8 with long sequences triggers a codepath that only runs when TRT_FUSE=1. Disabling should bypass the buggy kernel.
sylvia (oncall): Ok plan: 1) Patch DaemonSet to set TRT_FUSE=0 for inference-runtime, 2) Roll out with maxUnavailable=30% to preserve capacity, 3) Route critical customers to dedicated capacity while we stabilize. Emma, do the rollout. Kevin, prepare hotfix PR to revert fused kernel change.
emma (sre): Rolling now: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/inference-runtime TRT_FUSE=0 --record` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime`. Monitoring restart surge.
maria (customer-success): Heads-up: CS dashboard shows spike in 5xxs for ~12 hosted API customers; two enterprise customers on Dedicated report timeouts but no crashes (they're on dedicated pools). I'll ping affected accounts if we expect >30m disruption.
kevin (eng-runtime): Opening PR to revert fused commit and add extra unit/integration tests targeting long sequences + int8. I'll push a pinned image to quay `redwood/inference-runtime:v2.3.1-no-fuse` for emergency rollbacks.
emma (sre): After setting TRT_FUSE=0, crash rate dropped from 85% to ~5% on shard-14. Some older pods still in CrashLoopBackOff; I'm draining node-gpu-14 and forcing new pods to schedule on node-gpu-18 which has same driver but lower load. `kubectl drain node-gpu-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (in progress)
raj (eng-ml): Can we gate the fused kernel behind a canary flag per node label? We should avoid a global flip next time.
sylvia (oncall): Agreed for future. For now, primary concern is recovery. Emma, estimate time to <1% error rate.
emma (sre): Monitoring graph shows 504/5xxs trending down. Estimating 12-15m to full stabilization as new pods come up and in-flight requests drain.
maria (customer-success): I'll message customers: "We've identified a regression in a fused inference kernel introduced in v2.3.1. We're rolling back the fused path and performing a controlled restart. Expected recovery within 30 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigation steps." Any objections? :pray:
sylvia (oncall): No objections. Please include mitigation: disable TRT_FUSE and node relocation. Also include guidance for Dedicated customers: no config change needed unless they opt-in into fused path.
kevin (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge/4567 — revert + test. I'll also add runtime guard `--tune-fuse` boolean behind feature flag and log when kernel dispatch chooses fused path.
emma (sre): Nodes drained, new pods healthy on node-gpu-18/20. Error rate back to baseline ~0.3%. Rolling restarts complete.
sylvia (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Creating post-incident notes and assigning RCA to kevin/raj for root cause and test coverage. Handoff: I'm off at 23:00 UTC, handing to raj for next 12h watch. raj, please monitor customer escalations.
raj (eng-ml): Taking handoff. I'll run targeted reproductions (long sequences + int8) in staging and validate kernel paths. Will follow up with timeline for permanent fix. :thumbsup:
maria (customer-success): Thanks team — I'll update customers with resolution and ETA for full fix. Closing loop with affected accounts.
incident-bot: Incident update logged: severity=P2, impacted_customers=12, root_cause_placeholder=fused-trt-kernel-illegal-memory-access, mitigation=disable-trt-fuse + node relocation. Handed off to raj (eng-ml).
